decisions.reason: As a desk system that builds directly on the firm's established office and conference furniture capabilities, it fits its strong related knowledge and in-house R&D, so management would expect to refine rather than withdraw it.
A chair family is very close to the firm's core furniture offer, and with broad product experience, design collaboration, and own R&D, the firm has strong absorptive capacity to keep developing it.
Although more niche than core casegoods or seating, floor cushions from carpets still build on the firm's interior and material expertise, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
A soft upholstered sofa remains close to the firm's established lounge and residential interior business, and designer-led product development supports learning and improvement rather than exit.
A high standing table matches the firm's direction toward flexible workplace solutions and lies close to its existing knowledge base, so management would likely continue it.

A rug collection is more distant from the firm's established furniture focus, and despite having R&D and design strengths, management would see weaker ability to interpret results and justify keeping it versus concentrating resources on closer products.
